card.name: Bullerengue
card.profile: An Afro-Colombian baile cantado (sung dance) of the Caribbean coast (Bolivar, Cordoba, Sucre, Antioquia; San Basilio de Palenque area), led by elder women cantadoras in a call-and-response circle answered by chorus and handclaps (World Music Central; Universidad de Antioquia). Entirely percussive: tambor alegre (hembra), tambor llamador (macho), maracas; women dance in wide polleron skirts. Born in palenques (Maroon communities) as a vehicle of memory and resistance.
card.insight: George List made the oldest known field recording of bullerengue in Evitar, Bolivar, in 1964; the dance was declared Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial de la Nacion by Ley 2520 of 4 August 2025, alongside mapale and son de negro (El Tiempo; Congreso de Colombia).
